t: Conquered from 1830 in a long and brutal war, Algeria was governed as part of France, with three departments from 1848.
About a million European settlers held land and power, while some eight to nine million Muslims lived as subjects without full rights.
The war of independence from 1954 brought down the Fourth Republic and ended with Algerian independence on 5 July 1962.
dyk: The French Foreign Legion was founded in 1831 for service in Algeria and kept its headquarters at Sidi Bel Abbès until Algerian independence in 1962.
ev: French troops land at Sidi Ferruch and Algiers capitulates on 5 July
Abdelkader surrenders to French forces after fifteen years of resistance
Northern Algeria is divided into the French departments of Algiers, Oran and Constantine
The Crémieux Decree grants French citizenship to Algerian Jews
The Mokrani revolt is crushed and followed by large land confiscations
The Sétif and Guelma massacres follow riots on 8 May
The FLN launches the war of independence on 1 November
The Évian Accords end the war and Algeria becomes independent on 5 July

f.founder: Charles X of France (ordered the 1830 invasion)
